stages.description: Identify target dept/institution, budget head, decision-maker. Qualify fit for XR solution.
stages.exitCriteria: Department and budget confirmed. Champion identified. Fit confirmed.

stages.description: First contact via introduction, event connection, referral, or strategic cold outreach.
stages.exitCriteria: Meeting scheduled with decision-influencer or budget holder.

stages.description: Product demo customized to their specific use case (education, skill training, police, healthcare).
stages.exitCriteria: Positive feedback. Next steps agreed (pilot or proposal).
activities: Conduct live demo (in-person preferred for govt)
Record demo for sharing with committee

stages.description: Formal proposal or bid submitted — either direct procurement or tender response.
stages.exitCriteria: Proposal received and acknowledged. Evaluation timeline confirmed.

stages.description: Terms, scope, pricing, timeline negotiation. May involve presentations to evaluation committees.
stages.exitCriteria: Verbal or written agreement on commercial terms.

stages.description: Contract or Purchase Order signed. Pilot deployment begins.
stages.exitCriteria: PO received. Deployment started. First milestone delivered.
activities: Content customization with XR Content Head
